description: Four voltage controlled low frequency oscillators with four ways of linking them, each giving a sine, triangle, square, rising ramp and falling ramp output.

params.text: Sets the frequency of the first oscillator, 2 to the power of the knob value in Hz, so 1/128Hz to 128Hz.

Sets its oscillator's frequency from 1/128Hz to 128Hz in Free mode; in Quad it attenuates that oscillator, in Phase it shifts it 0 to 360 degrees, in Divide it divides the first oscillator by 2 to 32.
Links the four oscillators: Free runs each on its own, Quad locks them to the first 90 degrees apart, Phase locks them to the first with a shift you set, Divide runs them at divisions of the first.

inputs.text: Scales the value its knob sets, 0 to 5V; with nothing patched the knob acts at its full value.
A trigger above 2V restarts that oscillator's cycle from zero.

outputs.text: A square wave from that oscillator, swinging between -5V and 5V.
A rising ramp from that oscillator, swinging between -5V and 5V.
A falling ramp from that oscillator, swinging between -5V and 5V.
A sine wave from that oscillator, swinging between -5V and 5V.
A triangle wave from that oscillator, swinging between -5V and 5V.

notes: each oscillator has a lamp blinking at its own rate, coloured red in Free mode, green in Quad, blue in Phase and white in Divide.
